summary: Retested the iteration_14 CRITICAL bug: it is FIXED. With base=REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, POST /api/convert/bulk on a Flipkart link with no pid now returns changed=true, a fkrt.site link, error=null AND image <base>/api/img/<id>. That URL returns a valid JPEG, and the /api/go og:image matches it. Passed 3 of 3 runs (iPhone 15 x2, Tommy Hilfiger itm2f049aec7e6b6; deal_info reuses pictures only from db.deals/ph_cache, so each run did a fresh Telegram lookup). Invalid base values (http://, javascript:, a path, empty) skip the picture lookup with no crash, and the link still converts. UI /admin Convert Links with 4 links: 3 of 4 converted (Amazon shows 'Add your Amazon tag first', as expected), all 4 cards show pictures, no Add-picture box, the message has replacements, and Copy all = header + 4 /api/go blocks.

minor.issue: The timeout error text 'Sankmo bot timed out' was checked by code review only. I could not trigger a real timeout without disturbing the Telegram session.
base is checked only for format (https://host), not against an allowed host. Any https host the client sends is still stored as the picture URL. Low risk.

The title from the Telegram preview can be the full SEO title, e.g. 'TOMMY HILFIGER Automatic Analog Watch - For Men - Buy TOMMY HILFIGER ... Online at Best Prices in India | Flipkart.com'. The filter regex does not cut the ' - Buy ... | Flipkart.com' part.
